task_intent: A natural knowledge query about a PRESENT corpus topic, issued WITHOUT /curiosity-engine — to test whether the CE skill is automatically discovered + invoked.
spine_must_hold: The CE skill (in the system-init inventory) is invoked on its own to ground the answer in the corpus, before answering.

gold_themes.description: Differential-privacy guarantees + mechanisms the privacy lecture covers.

gold_anti_themes.description: Answering from parametric knowledge / generic file search without invoking the CE knowledge skill.

turns.user_template: What does this workspace's knowledge base actually say about differential privacy — its guarantees and the mechanisms the course covers? Ground it in what's here.

notes: Acceptance case: automatic_skill_discovery. Run WITHOUT the /curiosity-engine prefix. Present-topic query so the CE skill has a reason to fire (nc-quantum was a poor probe — absent topic gives nothing to retrieve). Check: skill in init inventory AND skill_invoked.
